query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.packageType,
  p.totalHours,
  p.usedHours,
  (p.totalHours - p.usedHours) * 60 as remainingMinutes,
  p.isActive,
  p.startDate,
  p.endDate
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka' AND p.isActive = true
LIMIT 1;
